title: 第201章 谋划巧遇第200章 对峙
content_zh:
任务大殿，马继章神识探入传音符箓中，微微一笑。
对于董戈在闲置洞府种植规定之外的灵药，他其实是知道一些的。
只是这么做的并不止他一人，若是揭穿，就是得罪所有这么做的人。
而且董戈之前并没有得罪他，他也没这个必要去揭穿。
不过如今情况有些变化了，他的孙子马寒山前段时间筑基成功了。
他想为马寒山安排一个好一点的职务，但看来看去，唯有任务殿安排洞府事宜和任务的这个位置最好。
一来就在他手底下做事情，他完全可以照顾到。
二来，安排洞府事宜和任务，容易结交好友，得到一些有潜力的弟子人情。
而如今这个位置被董戈的堂弟董松越占据。
这是他祖父董匡坐化前，用自己过去的人情换来的，鸡毛蒜皮的事情动不了对方。
赖沐的出现，正好给了他一把刀。
阴墨的弟子，又是中等的幽水灵体，潜力很高。
如今得罪了董戈那边，等后面成长起来后，肯定会报复回去，董松越也难以逃脱。
若是董戈那边出手，一旦被查出，自然也会牵连董松越。
那个时候，他的孙子也差不多筑基三层了。
身家背景清白，实力也足够，只要位置空闲出来，加上他出面，几乎板上钉钉。
只是这也有一个隐患。
那就是他的目的不能暴露，得咬死对于董戈种植违规灵药的事情不知情。
否则偷鸡不成蚀把米。
...

另一边，藏功山，奴心峰藏功楼所在之地。
阴阳御奴宗之中，有一个公共的藏功楼，所有的外门弟子便是在那边选择功法，传承等秘籍。
而成为内门弟子之后，便可进入六大主峰之一。
六大主峰各有藏功楼，正常情况下，中等、上品甚至顶尖的功法、法术、传承基本都有，只有一部分可能独属于某一峰。
除此之外，便是各大主峰的独有镇峰功法。
这是各峰底蕴，哪怕是同为一宗，也不会轻易让其他主峰之人观看修炼。
藏功山之外，顾景元落下。
领取的令牌中有规定，藏功山内不可御空而行。
顾景元收起法剑，一步一步开始朝着藏功山顶走去。
藏功山高数百丈，盘山而建，阶梯数万。
即便是筑基修士，若不动用灵力，也没那么容易登顶。
一步一阶梯，顾景元从容赶路。
中途也会遇见一些修士上下，有人好奇打量他，也有人视若无睹，但总归是没有人故意挑衅，甚至出手。
良久，顾景元终于登顶。
藏功楼是一座巨大的宫殿，周围还有几座略小一些的宫殿错落分布。
这些小一点的宫殿中，居住着镇守藏功楼的长老。
顾景元走到大殿前，亮出令牌给守卫查看之后，走入大殿之中。
content_en:
In the mission hall, Ma Jizhang's spiritual consciousness penetrated into the musical instrument and smiled slightly.
He actually knew something about Dong Ge's cultivation of elixirs outside the regulations in the idle cave.
It's just that he is not the only one who does this. If he exposes it, he will offend everyone who does this.
Moreover, Dong Ge had not offended him before, and he had no need to expose it.
But now the situation has changed. His grandson Ma Hanshan successfully built the foundation some time ago.
He wanted to arrange a better position for Ma Hanshan, but it seemed that only the position in the Mission Hall where the cave affairs and tasks were arranged was the best.
As soon as you come and do things under his hands, he can take care of them.
Secondly, by arranging matters and tasks in the cave, it is easier to make friends and gain favors from some potential disciples.
Now this position is occupied by Dong Ge's cousin Dong Songyue.
This was obtained by his grandfather Dong Kuang in exchange for his past favors before his death. Trivial matters could not touch the other party.
Lai Mu's appearance just gave him a knife.
Yin Mo's disciple is also a medium-level Nether Water spirit body with high potential.
Now that he has offended Dong Ge, he will definitely take revenge when he grows up later, and Dong Songyue will not be able to escape.
If Dong Ge takes action, once he is found out, Dong Songyue will naturally be implicated.
At that time, his grandson had almost built the third floor of the foundation.
He has a clean financial background and sufficient strength. As long as the position is free and he comes forward, it is almost certain.
But there is also a hidden danger.
That is, his purpose cannot be exposed, and he must be killed for not knowing about Dong Ge's planting of illegal elixirs.
Otherwise, you will lose the rice by stealing the chicken.
...
On the other side, there is Zanggong Mountain, where the Nuxinfeng Zanggong Tower is located.
In the Yin-Yang Royal Slave Sect, there is a public Tibetan Kung Fu Building, where all the outer disciples choose techniques, inheritance and other secrets.
After becoming an inner disciple, you can enter one of the six main peaks.
Each of the six main peaks has its own Kung Fu Pavilion. Under normal circumstances, there are basically medium, high-grade and even top-grade kungfu, spells, and inheritances. Only some of them may belong to a certain peak.
In addition, there are the unique peak-suppressing techniques for each major peak.
This is the foundation of each peak. Even if they are from the same sect, they will not easily let people from other main peaks watch their practice.
Outside Hidden Gong Mountain, Gu Jingyuan fell.
The token you received stipulates that you are not allowed to fly in the air inside the Hidden Gong Mountain.
Gu Jingyuan put away his magic sword and started walking towards the top of the mountain of Zanggong step by step.
Hidden Gong Mountain is hundreds of feet high, built winding up the mountain, and has tens of thousands of steps.
Even for foundation-building monks, it is not that easy to reach the top without using spiritual power.
Step by step, Gu Jingyuan hurried on calmly.
Along the way, he would meet some monks. Some looked at him curiously, while others turned a blind eye. But in the end, no one deliberately provoked or even took action.
After a long time, Gu Jingyuan finally reached the top.
The Zanggong Tower is a huge palace with several smaller palaces scattered around it.
In these smaller palaces, there live the elders who guard the Tibetan Gong Tower.
Gu Jingyuan walked to the front of the main hall, showed his token to the guards for inspection, and then walked into the main hall.
